installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Realms of Ashenvale - Pterodactyl install script
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/IhleMa/idle-rpg}"
BRANCH="${BRANCH:-main}"
[[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]] && GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
if [[ -n "${USERNAME}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
  echo "Existing install found - updating to latest ${BRANCH} (your data/ folder is kept)."
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  git fetch origin "${BRANCH}"
  git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
  echo "Cloning ${BRANCH} from repository..."
  rm -rf /tmp/game && git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/game
  cp -a /tmp/game/. /mnt/server/
  rm -rf /tmp/game
fi

echo "Installing Node.js dependencies..."
npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
echo "Install complete."
